items.rationale: The washing-machine leak is an escape of water under §2.4.2, and §7.1.7(h) covers necessary cleaning of the wetted floor. Estimate €85 for one cleaning item, benchmarked against Case 12's combined charge.
The hallway floor was also wetted, so its cleaning qualifies separately under §7.1.7(h). Estimate €95 for one cleaning item within the Case 12 combined benchmark.
Section 7.1.7(e) covers inspecting the source to confirm that it no longer leaks, even if the appliance itself is not insured. Estimate €90 for one inspection.

items.description: Remove and dispose of damaged skirting
items.rationale: Damaged fixed skirting is a building component under §4.2.2, and §7.1.7(a) covers its removal and disposal. Estimate €65 for one item.
Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like replacement of the damaged fixed trim. Estimate €135 installed for one item, bringing positions 1–5 to €470, within Case 12's combined range.

items.description: Clean and repaint unaffected upstairs bedroom
items.rationale: Sections 3.5 and 7.1.5 exclude both tasks because the bedroom was not reached by the water. The conditional estimate is €650 for one combined cleaning and repainting item.

items.description: Moisture measurement in utility room and hallway
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(b) covers moisture measurement on both affected floors. Estimate €170 for the single invoiced measurement item, consistent with Case 21.

Section 7.1.7(b) covers necessary drying of the affected floors, but §7.1.8(c) bars paying the same cost again. Estimate €190 for the drying service itself, excluding the separately listed rental and labour.

Section 7.1.7(e) covers equipment hire for necessary drying, provided the rental is not already included in position 8. Estimate €130 for one rental item; positions 7–10 together total €642, within Case 12's combined range.

Section 7.1.7(g) covers skilled labour attributable to the affected areas, subject to the duplicate-cost exclusion in §7.1.8(c). At the stated gross prior of €38 per hour, four invoiced hours total €152.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(b) exclude measurement and drying in a separate room with no documented leak damage. The conditional estimate is €350 for one combined item.

items.description: Transport of hallway painting to restorer
items.rationale: Section 5.2.6 covers specialist transport in principle, but restoration takes first priority and is expected to exhaust the shared €1,190 gross limit. If restoration leaves a balance, transport is next in invoice order, with an estimated ceiling of €120.
Section 5.2.6 covers the assessment, but only from the balance left after restoration and transport. The conditional estimate is up to €180 for one assessment, subject to that balance.

items.description: Drying and stabilisation of hallway painting
items.rationale: Section 5.2.6 covers stabilisation in principle, but this line receives only what remains after restoration, transport and assessment. The conditional estimate is up to €240 for one treatment, subject to that balance.

Under §5.2.6, restoration has first claim on the single €1,000 net limit for this affected, unscheduled painting. Full specialist restoration is estimated to reach the limit, giving €1,190 gross at 19% VAT under §7.7.

Section 5.2.6 applies only to an item affected by the insured event; the second painting was expressly unaffected. The conditional estimate for one comparable restoration is €1,190 gross at the unscheduled-item limit.
Section 7.1.8(b) expressly excludes separate administrative and processing charges. The €35 conditional estimate is a nominal amount for one flat fee, not an allowance.
